title: Special Edition: The Shield Hero’s Valentine’s Day Part 14
text: Well, today is Filo’s Valentine’s Day event. By the way, I spotted Motoyasu waiting in front of the event venue yesterday. Actually, I see him there every single time.

This time, Filo’s chocolates come with handshake tickets and points coupons for limited-edition merchandise. I’m looking forward to seeing just how many Motoyasu ends up buying… or am I? After all, that means my wallet will be a little fuller. Incidentally, I still clearly remember how Filo always looks reluctant whenever she’s forced to do handshakes.

She’s Member No. 001 of Filo’s Personal Guard and the group’s president. Apparently, it’s a strict organization that will punish anyone who tries to make a pass at Filo. Well, Motoyasu wouldn’t lay a finger on Filo anyway… That’s why I heard from Melty that Filo’s stalkers and the like are dealt with by Motoyasu and the rest of the Personal Guard. All things considered, since Filo travels all the way to the Glass World to perform as an idol, her Guard must be tagging along over a pretty wide area.
I used to be an otaku myself, so I’m not completely clueless about this. Not an idol otaku, though.
“Naofumi-sama!”
“Hm?”
Atla came over with Fohl and called out to me.
“What is it?”
“Here’s a chocolate gift from me!”
Just as Atla said that—or maybe at the exact same moment—there was a “ting” sound, and a heart-shaped chocolate popped out of my shield. It had the kind of force you’d expect from a toaster.
She interfered with the shield to make that chocolate, didn’t she? After catching it, I checked the chocolate to make sure nothing weird was inside.
Heart-Shaped Chocolate: Quality—Top Grade
Even though my shield made it, the quality is top grade… That’s quite a clever trick.
“Atla, that’s cheating. You used Lord Naofumi’s shield to make this, didn’t you?”
“Use whatever is available to give the very best. That’s the way to go.”
Raphtalia and Atla started glaring at each other. As for me… I broke the heart-shaped chocolate in half lengthwise and handed one half to Fohl.
“Na-Naofumi-sama?”
Raphtalia let out a voice, left speechless by the scene. Fohl kept glancing back and forth between the chocolate and me.
“What’s wrong? It’s the chocolate you’ve been longing for—made by Atla herself.”
“Ah, ah…”
Fohl had a similar look on his face. I’m sure he thinks it’s terrible. After all, I’m breaking a heart-shaped chocolate in half.
“It’s a taste test, I know. Come on, big brother, eat it to prove my innocence to Naofumi-sama.”
But Atla’s resolve is as strong as steel. I knew something like this wouldn’t faze her in the least. Fohl silently ate the chocolate Atla had made—the one I handed him, made from a shield.
“Nothing wrong with it?”
“W-well, sort of…”
“Savor it well. Is there any hair or strange impurities in it?”
“N-no.”
Fohl’s face was slightly red. But there didn’t seem to be anything unusual.
“Are you physically intolerant of chocolate?”
“No…”
“I see. Well then, I’ll have the rest.”

I put the remaining half in my mouth. Mmm, it’s actually pretty good. It’s a bit hard to believe it was really made from a shield, but it did actually come from the shield. Or rather, where did the ingredients come from…? Was it from when all the heroes mass-produced chocolate?
“What do you think?”
“Ah, it’s delicious. This is good enough to serve in a store.”
“I’m glad to hear that. But unfortunately, there’s only one.”
“Why’s that?”
“I made it just for Naofumi-sama, and it uses more than three times the usual amount of ingredients.”
It tastes good, but it doesn’t seem worth the effort. I bet it takes a long time to make, too. Well, I guess that’s just typical of Atla.
Still, it’s hard to tell if Atla really gets it or not, but she sure knows how to tickle a guy’s heart. My heart skipped a beat.
“Fohl-nii! Me too, me too!”
Keel hands a chocolate crepe to Fohl. Fohl looks blatantly unimpressed—or rather, he’s furrowing his brow, clearly at a loss for how to respond.
“Th-thanks.”
“Hehe, this is delicious! You should try some too, bro.”
“Ah, yeah, yeah.”
Keel sure is full of energy. I mean, you’re supposed to be waiting backstage at the venue. Just like Filo and Melty!
“Keel, you’re performing in the event, so head over there early.”
“O-okay.”
Keel flew off using his sickle portal skill.
“Na-o-hu-mi-chaaan!”

Ugh… a voice I really don’t want to hear. When I turned around, the woman who exudes an overflowing love for me on par with Atla—the orca girl Sadeena—was waving and waddling toward me. Even though there haven’t been many days lately when I haven’t run into her during salvage missions or something… I guess she’d come see me on Valentine’s Day, after all.
“W-what’s up?”
“It’s Valentine’s Day today. I’m thinking of giving Naofumi-chan some chocolate, too.”
“Sorry, but I don’t want any.”
You barely even helped make the chocolates, did you? No matter how I look at it, I can already see how this is going to turn out.
“It looks like there might be something weird in there.”
You’re the first person who comes to mind when I think of someone who’d put weird stuff in homemade chocolates.
“Oh, well then, I’ll make my special chocolate right in front of you, Naofumi-chan, so watch closely.”
“I don’t really have time for that…”
“Don’t worry, I won’t take up much of your time. Here are the ingredients.”

With that, she showed me a note listing the ingredients. Chocolate and milk… and Lucor Fruit… So she’s going to have me prepare them and make it right in front of me? Well, if that’s the case, at least I can be sure nothing weird will end up in it.
“…Alright, I get it.”
There’s some leftover chocolate in the kitchen anyway. I prepared the chocolate and milk just as she said. I had someone fetch the Lucor Fruit from the storeroom.
“Well then, I’ll make it right away,”

Sadeena said as she picked up a metal pot, poured in the chocolate and milk, and infused it with a faint bolt of lightning Magic. After a while, the heat from the lightning began to melt the chocolate. She stirred it, then grabbed a bamboo skewer from the kitchen and skewered a Lucor Fruit with it. This is…
“Now, just do this… here you go.”

She dipped the Lucor Fruit into the melted, gooey chocolate and held it up to my mouth. Chocolate fondue? True enough—there’s no way anyone could sneak anything weird into this. It’s just a regular chocolate treat, though only I can eat it.
“Come on—the chocolate’s going to harden!”
“Got it.”
I popped the chocolate-coated Lucor Fruit she handed me into my mouth. Immediately, Sadeena dipped the next Lucor Fruit into the chocolate and started feeding it to me.
“Haa…”

With every one I eat, Sadeena smiles with a dreamy look in her eyes while letting out a deep sigh. What on earth is going on? Eventually, after feeding me a whole cluster of Lucor Fruit, she sets the pot down with a thud.
“Well, since my Valentine’s Day is over, I’m off to work.”
“Oh, I heard there’s a wrap-up party tonight, so you should head to Zeltoble later.”
“Right. I’ll see you there later, then. By the way, Big Sister, for my White Day gift, I want the white chocolate seeping out from under Naofumi-chan.”
“Don’t be ridiculous.”

What’s with this ‘white chocolate seeping out from under’ nonsense! She’s pulling that cliché joke again! But… that’s surprising. I thought she’d keep making those persistent sexual harassment comments and maybe even splash some chocolate on me.
“The Valentine’s chocolate is mine—me—me!”
I thought she’d say something like that and pounce on me. Actually, Sadeena would totally do something like that, right?
After that, Sadeena didn’t do anything particularly bold; she just skipped away. What was that all about?
“Sadeena-Big Sister… she had such a girlish look in her eyes and let out a little sigh.”
“She must love Naofumi-sama—who can hold his liquor so well—that much. I can’t let myself be outdone!”
“Yeah, yeah.”
Well, it’s good enough that Sadeena didn’t go off the rails. I wonder if she likes me because I don’t get drunk on Lucor Fruit that easily… I really don’t get her standards.
“Well then, let’s head to the event venue too.”
Once we were ready, we used a portal to teleport to the venue where Filo and Keel were selling chocolate. The venue was the Zeltoble Colosseum. It’s nice that it’s connected to the event venue, too.
“There are so many people here.”
“Yeah.”

That’s because Melromarc and Zeltoble ran ads… Apparently, the Filolial Race venue is nearby, too. Looking at the venue, there’s a huge line. Filo’s fans… there sure are a lot of grown-up fans. I guess idols are the same no matter where you go.
“Ten minutes until the doors open!”
The fans are getting excited at that announcement. …Sure enough, Motoyasu is at the front of the line. I wonder how many hours ago he started waiting.

By the way, he looks different than usual. He’s wearing a headband, a weird happi coat with a picture of Filo on it, and he’s even hanging a furoshiki bag filled with a massive amount of chocolate exchange tickets from his spear as he waits. It’s a sight that makes me feel kind of sorry for him. I wonder if this is how the people who despise idol otaku feel.

The three Filolial Reals, gazing at Motoyasu, looked troubled as they seemed to be planning their stage invasion. Did you guys give Motoyasu some chocolate? I guess you probably did… Though I’m sure he’s actually just craving Filo’s chocolate (he must have seen the manufacturing process).
Behind him… or rather, there are a lot of guys wearing those weird happi coats. They’re the same ones Motoyasu is wearing.
“Come on! Members of Filo-tan’s Personal Guard, let the battle begin!”
“Let’s mete out bloody punishment to any fools who try to do anything indecent to Filo-tan!”
“‘Bloody punishment!’”
“All for the sake of Filo-tan!”
“‘For the sake of Filo-tan!’”
“Let’s spread our love for Filo-tan without discrimination, even to those who don’t understand our words!”
“‘All for the sake of goodwill!’”
……I silently glance over at Raphtalia. Filo’s fans are something else. I looked away, trying not to meet Raphtalia’s gaze.

Come to think of it… Raphtalia acts strangely distant toward Motoyasu. She keeps a much greater distance from him than she does from Ren or Itsuki. Well, I guess no one really wants to have anything to do with that pervert. Except for the Tricolor Filolials and those related to the Filolials, that is.

Like… if Motoyasu calls her “Sister-in-law!” or something, she looks really annoyed. Did something happen when they brought Motoyasu to this world? It’s been like that ever since then. Raphtalia and the others were late arriving, and it’s not hard to imagine that he was the reason why. I haven’t asked for the details, but he probably did something terrible.
“Um, shouldn’t we get going soon?”
“…Yeah, you’re right.”
And so, we set off.
